question: **Select the correctly spelt word. **
solution:
The correctly spelt word is: **Narrative** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The spelling of "**Narrative**" is correct. Rest other spellings are incorrect.
 
• Narrative means the description of events in a story. (कहानी में घटनाओं का वर्णन)
 
• Let's look at other options:
 
• Monotanous = Its correct spelling is **Monotonous**. 
 
 
• **Monotonous **means never changing and therefore boring. (परिवर्तन-रहित और अतएव उबाऊ, अरोचक, नीरस)
 
 
 
• Meticulious = Its correct spelling is **Meticulous**. 
 
 
• **Meticulous **means giving or showing great attention to detail; very careful. (विस्तार पर बहुत ध्यान देना या दिखाना; बहुत सावधान)
 
 
 
• Exilerate = Its correct spelling is **Exhilarate**. 
 
 
• **Exhilarate **means to make somebody feel very excited and happy. (किसी को बहुत उत्साहित और खुश महसूस कराने के लिए)
 
 

Therefore, **option 3** is the correct answer.
